newsitem.title: CHINA: ING to open third bank branch in China.
newsitem.headline: ING to open third bank branch in China.

text.p: Dutch financial services group Internationale Nederlanden Groep NV (ING) on Tuesday announced the October opening of its third Chinese bank branch.
The branch in Xiamen city in the southeastern province of Fujian would open on October 23, ING Group executive board member Herman Huizinga told a news conference in Beijing.
ING Bank's existing bank branches in Shanghai and Shenzhen were already prospering, Huizinga said but gave no details.
ING, whose China loan portfolio was worth around $1.0 billion, planned to further expand its network of branches and representative offices in China, he said.

ING has applied for permission to open branches in Beijing, northern Tianjin city and northeastern Dalian, but faces stiff competition from other foreign banks eager to establish a presence in China's potentially huge financial market.
